messages:
Eve Chan: Quick heads-up — intake for a new SI field-tech runbook. We need to collect: lab access instructions, DevOps automation bits, certification rubric, and a short co-branding checklist from partners. Draft doc: https://drive.internal/redwood/si-field-runbook (please request access if you can't open).

Ravi Patel: Got it. Can we make the cert rubric explicit? i.e., pass/fail criteria for each hands-on station so SIs know what's required for certification.

Eve Chan: Yes. Looking for 3 clear buckets: infra, deployment, ops. Also need automation for cluster credentials so trainees aren't stuck on day 0. @Kai Morgan can you weigh in on the kubeconfig provisioning script?

Kai Morgan: I can. I propose a namespaced service account pattern and short helper script. Example template:

```bash
# create SA and bind to test namespace
kubectl create namespace si-training-<org>
kubectl create serviceaccount si-trainee -n si-training-<org>
kubectl create rolebinding si-trainee-admin --clusterrole=edit --serviceaccount=si-training-<org>:si-trainee -n si-training-<org>
# export kubeconfig
TOKEN=$(kubectl -n si-training-<org> get secret $(kubectl -n si-training-<org> get sa si-trainee -o jsonpath="{.secrets[0].name}") -o jsonpath="{.data.token}" | base64 --decode)
# ... helper writes minimal kubeconfig with token
```

Kai Morgan: I need the allowed namespace list and the test cluster name. I can drop a PR with the script by Thu. :clock3:

Anika Singh: For the certification rubric, here's a compact checklist we can paste into the runbook: 

```
- Infra setup (30m): provision namespaced cluster access, deploy ingress, storage check
  - CHECKPOINT: Trainee can `kubectl get pods` in namespace and explain RBAC choices (pass/fail)
- Model deploy (60m): pull model image, run inference pod, run simple perf check
  - CHECKPOINT: Model responds to test request with <= 500ms p50 and correct output schema
- Monitoring & rollback (30m): wire up Prometheus scrape, trigger a canary rollback
  - CHECKPOINT: Trainee can initiate rollback and verify traffic shift (pass/fail)
```

Anika Singh: Add a 10-point partial credit rubric for edge cases (timeouts, quantization regressions).

Lena Ortiz: Also include a short partner-facing co-brand checklist so marketing knows when to approve: logo assets, approved partner description (2 sentences), joint announcement approval owner and date. I'll add a one-page checklist under Marketing section.

SI Onboarding Bot: Created issue #789 in GH: partnerships/si-runbooks — "field-tech-runbook-intake". Assigned: @Eve, @Ravi, @Kai. Link: https://gh.internal/redwood/partnerships/issues/789

Ravi Patel: Timeline proposal: intake review by Tue EOD, draft runbook by Thu, two half-day training sessions the following week (Wed/Thu). I'll hold provisional calendar invites until we lock dates.

Eve Chan: Sounds good. Quick operational asks: 1) Kai — confirm script by Thu; 2) Marketing (Lena) — add co-brand items by Wed; 3) Anika — finalize rubric and partial-credit rules by Wed. I'll collect everything and run a 30m dry-run Friday.

Kai Morgan: Confirmed — script PR by Thu. Filed cluster access request: https://infra.internal/redwood/requests/456 (please add test org names there).

Lena Ortiz: Added a minimal co-brand checklist to the doc and uploaded logo pack. Link in doc. :white_check_mark:

Anika Singh: Rubric updated with partial-credit examples. Pushed into the draft doc.

Eve Chan: Perfect — thanks team. If no objections I'll convert draft to the partner-facing runbook after the dry-run. :thumbsup:
